plugin_desc: Fibrolan Falcon carrier Ethernet and IEEE 1588 transmission SNMP child template (FIBROLAN-DEVICE, enterprise PEN 4467). Beyond the shared Transmission SNMP floor for MIB-II uptime and IF-MIB 64-bit HC interface traffic, it walks flDeviceCpuUtilization to cpu_usage_percent and flDeviceMemoryUtilization to memory_usage_percent, both reported directly as 0-100 percentages. The FIBROLAN-DEVICE index is often 0; the columns are walked and a non-0 index is not hardcoded. Optional NV memory utilization is collected from the sibling column when the device returns it. Temperature, fan and power-supply health are not exposed as stable shared scalars in this pass, so they are N/A. Supported brands/models — Fibrolan Falcon carrier Ethernet and IEEE 1588 transmission devices under enterprise 4467.
name: Transmission

metrics.name: cpu_usage_percent
metrics.description: CPU utilization of the Fibrolan Falcon platform from FIBROLAN-DEVICE flDeviceCpuUtilization (enterprise PEN 4467), reported directly as a 0-100 percentage. The column is walked because the table index is often 0 and must not be hardcoded to a non-0 value.

metrics.name: memory_usage_percent
metrics.description: DRAM utilization of the Fibrolan Falcon platform from FIBROLAN-DEVICE flDeviceMemoryUtilization (enterprise PEN 4467), reported directly as a 0-100 percentage. The column is walked; a non-0 index is not hardcoded.

metrics.name: nv_memory_usage_percent
metrics.description: Optional non-volatile memory utilization from FIBROLAN-DEVICE under enterprise PEN 4467 (sibling column of DRAM utilization). Some firmware revisions omit this column. The value is reported as a 0-100 percentage when present.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCOutOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
